parsed.rationale: All four participating records are anonymous extensions (name is empty string, fields_or_signature is empty) spread across test files in two packages (Playback and MusicShareKit). The cluster carries no structural evidence — jaccard, shared_field_count, shared_ancestor, and differing_slots are all null — meaning the pipeline surfaced these records solely on the 'Tag' name collision signal, but none of the records actually bear that name. With no shared members, no shared ancestor, and no meaningful overlap to consolidate, there is nothing actionable to extract or unify.
